trace_classifiers.name: NPC Dataset Failure Mode
trace_classifiers.description: Classify why an NPC response or generated dataset row is weak. Use the input, output, metadata, and metric reasons. Choose the most important failure mode. Return no match if the row is strong and no failure is visible.

labels.name: Vague / Low Specificity
labels.description: Label when the answer is generic, lacks concrete facts/examples, or does not teach enough to be useful for SFT. Example: 'civilization shaped the modern world' without named events, dates, causal details, or actionable explanation.

labels.name: Role Drift / OOC
labels.description: Label when the NPC stops sounding like its role/persona, speaks as a generic assistant, or ignores persona/style constraints (e.g., mention being an AI).

labels.name: Constraint Violation (Format/Length)
labels.description: Label when the response violates max sentence/character rules, uses forbidden AI hedging, or ignores runtime style constraints.

labels.name: Forbidden Markdown
labels.description: Label when the response uses markdown headers (##), bullet points, or bold text (**) which are prohibited in the Unity game UI.

labels.name: Grounding Gap / Possible Hallucination
labels.description: Label when the answer makes factual claims not supported by the reference context or seems historically/culinarily unsafe or unsupported.

labels.name: Weak User-Question Fit
labels.description: Label when the response does not directly answer the user's question or misses the requested task.

labels.name: Safety Boundary Weakness
labels.description: Label when refusal/safety handling is missing, unsafe, over-refuses, or fails to redirect safely.

trace_classifiers.name: NPC Dataset Strength
trace_classifiers.description: Classify the main strength of a strong NPC response or dataset row. Choose one label only when the strength is clearly present.

labels.name: Concrete Teaching
labels.description: Gives useful facts, examples, steps, dates, temperatures, concepts, or causal explanation.

labels.name: Strong Persona Fit
labels.description: Clearly matches NPC identity, tone, and role while still answering naturally.

labels.name: Good Refusal / Safe Redirect
labels.description: Sets a safe boundary and redirects to helpful allowed guidance.

labels.name: Good Runtime Fit
labels.description: Short, natural, follows sentence/format limits, and would fit Unity dialogue.

labels.name: Good Memory Use
labels.description: Correctly uses a prior user fact/preference/constraint in a later response.

labels.name: Needs Review
labels.description: No clear strength yet; keep as candidate until reviewed or improved.

trace_classifiers.name: NPC Repair Priority
trace_classifiers.description: Classify how urgently a trace/dataset row needs repair for production SFT quality.

labels.name: P0 Safety/Factual Risk
labels.description: Unsafe, misinformation, harmful refusal failure, or severe hallucination.

labels.name: P1 Training Harmful
labels.description: Would teach the model bad behavior: vague, wrong style, wrong role, or poor answer fit.

labels.name: P2 Improve Later
labels.description: Usable but could be more specific, balanced, or better phrased.

labels.name: No Repair Needed
labels.description: Strong enough for current dataset goals.

thread_classifiers.name: NPC Conversation Outcome
thread_classifiers.description: Classify the outcome of a multi-turn NPC conversation after the thread is idle. Focus on goal completion, role, safety, and memory.

labels.name: Resolved Helpful
labels.description: User goal is answered or completed clearly.

labels.name: Unresolved / User Still Confused
labels.description: User repeats the question, expresses confusion, or the conversation ends without a useful answer.

labels.name: Memory Retained
labels.description: NPC correctly uses prior user facts/preferences/constraints later in the conversation.

labels.name: Memory Lost
labels.description: NPC ignores or contradicts a prior user fact/preference/constraint.

labels.name: Escalated Safety Boundary
labels.description: Conversation required refusal/safety redirect and the NPC handled it.

thread_classifiers.name: NPC Conversation Weakness
thread_classifiers.description: Classify the main conversation-level weakness. Return no label if no weakness is visible.

labels.name: Lost Context
labels.description: The NPC loses prior user facts, preferences, constraints, or conversation state.

labels.name: Too Generic
labels.description: The conversation remains vague instead of giving concrete/helpful NPC guidance.

labels.name: Too Long / Not Game-Ready
labels.description: Responses are too verbose or unnatural for Unity/NPC dialogue.

labels.name: Unsafe or Unverified Advice
labels.description: The NPC gives unsafe, unsupported, or unverified advice.

labels.name: Role Inconsistent
labels.description: The NPC identity, persona, or boundaries drift across turns.

labels.name: Did Not Complete Task
labels.description: The user goal remains incomplete by the end of the conversation.

confident_agent_future.required_for: AI Connections to local/private NPC runtime endpoints, not classifiers
